description: Conditional on explicit cooldown synchronization approval and architecture review. Owner Zaq.People.AuthRateLimiter and Engine supervisor; read moduledocs before editing. Tests FIRST through real Hammer and PubSub: distinct person/IP send budgets, failed-identification-only IP accounting, tagged fail-closed typed config reads every operation, independent cooldown not extended while blocked, fresh budget after expiry, config changes, actual peer convergence and Engine-only startup. No email keys or SQL counters. Trusted canonical IP tuples only. Dependency candidate hammer 7.5.0 built-in ETS plus official application-owned PubSub pattern; no dependency added yet. No library mocks; controllable supported clock or minimal justified elapsed-time tests. Document topology, accepted overshoot and restart/partition limits honestly. Update people-access and Engine docs; format, tests, coverage.
